notes: UNITS: All primary sources publish dimensions already in cm (WTH/HT/PROJ cm); no mm conversion was needed. No published Sientra ladder contains a 'Moderate Plus 300cc' or 'High 400cc' size - the nearest published sizes were cross-checked instead (MP 285/305cc; HP 385/415cc). KNOWN CONFLICTS: (1) Moderate Plus 455cc projection: 4.8cm in MDC-0343 R3 (2019) and MDC-0177 R6 (2017) vs 4.6cm in MDC-0270 R11 (2022). (2) Xtra High 245cc row exists only in MDC-0270 R11; the 2019 catalog and current sientra.com start Xtra High at 275cc. GAPS: (a) Oval Base shaped tables exist only in the 2017 catalog (MDC-0177 R6, legacy Silimed-era generation); no OPUS-era per-size oval base table was found - current sientra.com lists only 2 teardrop projections (moderate 160-700, high 190-635) and the oval base may be discontinued. (b) FDA PMA P070004C Table 1 and the 2025 patient brochure (MDC-0010 R6) approve wider ranges than the marketed OPUS ladders (e.g. smooth Moderate style 10512 approved 80-700cc, smooth High style 10521 95-695cc, textured Low style 20610 60-700cc, classic base style 20676-E 115-690cc) - per-size dimensions for those legacy sub-ladder sizes (e.g. 10512 below 190cc) are NOT published in any located document. (c) The pre-2015 'Smooth Round High' (style 10521, renamed Moderate-High in 2014) is a different, lower-profile product than the current OPUS High (10621) - do not conflate. (d) Classic Base High per-size values are single-source (MDC-0400 R4). SOURCES: MDC-0343 R3 and MDC-0177 R6 are official Sientra documents whose PDFs are mirrored on a clinic site (sanfranciscobreast.com); MDC-0270 R11, MDC-0400 R4 and MDC-0704 R3 are hosted on Sientra's own domain (dev.sientra.com). FDA PMA P070004C (accessdata.fda.gov) was used for range-level corroboration only - it publishes min/max ranges, not per-size ladders.
